description.value: Okanagan Estate Wine Cellars is a Kitsilano neighbourhood wine shop devoted exclusively to British Columbia wines, sourced from regional winemakers and sold at winery prices with no obligations to hotels or restaurants. The 3669 West 4th Avenue location is one of two Vancouver stores and offers in-store wine flights and tastings alongside online ordering with in-store pickup. Staff are trained specifically in BC wine and food pairing, making it a useful stop for cyclists looking to bring home a bottle from their tour.
